hook.name: Jackprint
hook.description: A single-position lottery hook for an ETH/token pool. Buys record lottery tickets proportional to USD value via a Chainlink ETH/USD price feed; sells cancel tickets. LP fees are split 75% to a prize drawer and 25% to a creator address via an external Tickets contract. Enforces a single locked liquidity position and a launch-window per-block buy cap.
